tong_quan.chan_dung: People with Life Path 1 are often described as trailblazers: standing in front of an empty space, they see a place to begin rather than a risk. They learn by doing it themselves, stumbling, and getting back up — and they rarely wait for permission.
tong_quan.dong_luc: Deciding for yourself and seeing your own mark on the work you do.
diem_manh: Decide fast and own the decision
Get things started while others are still discussing
Stay the course once a goal is chosen
diem_mu: Hear feedback as a challenge, so react before hearing it all
See asking for help as weakness, so carry everything until you burn out
Let the people beside you 'shrink' without noticing
tong_quan.khi_cang_thang: Tightening control: doing everything yourself, deciding alone, speaking shorter and harder than usual.
tong_quan.huong_lon: From 'I can do it alone' to 'I can lead others to do it with me' — real strength is letting other people grow too.

tinh_cam.cach_yeu: Loves through action: protecting, providing, coming up with a plan. Likes to take the lead from the first date to the decision to commit.
tinh_cam.can_duoc: Respect for their decisions, recognition of their effort, and some room of their own without being called distant.
tinh_cam.diem_mu: Tends to decide for both people; treats the partner's feelings as 'a problem to solve' rather than something to listen to.
tinh_cam.hop_kieu_nguoi: Someone with their own opinions, steady enough to say 'no' to them and still stay.
tinh_cam.dau_hieu_lech: When the partner says less and less about what they want and only 'whatever you like' is left — that is a sign the 1 is taking over.
tinh_cam.hon_nhan: Usually takes the role of the pillar and makes most of the big decisions; needs to practise discussing before deciding, especially about money and where to live.

cong_viec.the_manh: Initiating, leading, working independently, handling the pressure of decisions.
cong_viec.moi_truong: A place where they are given authority, measured by results, with little waiting for approval.
cong_viec.vai_tro: Project starter, team lead, self-employed business owner.
nghe: Starting a business, running your own venture
Engineering or architecture designing new solutions
cong_viec.cai_bay: Starts a lot, hands over little; finds it hard to work under someone they do not respect.
cong_viec.tien_bac: Willing to back their own ideas; can spend big because they trust their own judgement — have a rule or a person who pushes back before any large spend.

bien_co.kieu_bien_co: The turning points people with this number tend to recall are moments of having to stand alone: leaving home early, losing a support, being pushed into the decision-maker's seat before feeling ready.
bien_co.cach_di_qua: When life puts you in a spot where you have to decide, decide — but tell at least one person you trust before you act.

tong_quan.chan_dung: Life Path 2 is often described as the person who senses the mood in a room before anyone says a word. They are the glue of the group: mediating, connecting, keeping everyone able to sit at the same table.
tong_quan.dong_luc: Being in warm, give-and-take relationships and being needed by others.
diem_manh: Listen deeply, read other people's feelings
Work well with others, build lasting teamwork
Patient, comfortable with a slow pace
diem_mu: Avoid conflict until a small issue becomes a big one
Say 'yes' when you mean 'no'
Measure your own worth by other people's reactions
tong_quan.khi_cang_thang: Withdrawing, going quiet, blaming yourself; holding on to hurt without saying it.
tong_quan.huong_lon: From 'keep the peace at any cost' to 'tell the truth kindly' — real harmony needs your voice too.

tinh_cam.cach_yeu: Loves through attention: remembering small details, tending to feelings, staying quietly close.
tinh_cam.can_duoc: To be sure they are loved — through words, presence and consistency.
tinh_cam.diem_mu: Tends to dissolve into the other person and forget what they want; gets angry without saying so, then hurts quietly.
tinh_cam.hop_kieu_nguoi: Someone warm who speaks plainly and asks how they are without needing to be read.
tinh_cam.dau_hieu_lech: When the 2 starts saying 'never mind' and stops telling their own stories — the distance is growing.
tinh_cam.hon_nhan: Values closeness and a peaceful home; needs to practise setting boundaries with both families.

cong_viec.the_manh: Coordinating, supporting, soft negotiation, customer care, careful detailed work.
cong_viec.moi_truong: A harmonious team with a clear leader, where quiet contributions are recognised.
cong_viec.vai_tro: Right hand, coordinator, the person who connects the parties.
nghe: Music or the arts where finesse matters
cong_viec.cai_bay: Does a lot but does not speak up to claim their share; gets handed 'nameless' tasks beyond their capacity.
cong_viec.tien_bac: Careful and drawn to safety; tends to lend money out of politeness — set a clear limit before helping anyone.

bien_co.kieu_bien_co: Turning points often come through relationships: a break-up, a betrayal of trust, or a person arriving at the right moment who changes the direction.
bien_co.bai_hoc: Sensitivity is a gift when it comes with boundaries.
bien_co.cach_di_qua: When a relationship is shaking, ask 'what do I need?' before asking 'what does the other person think?'.

tong_quan.chan_dung: Life Path 3 is often described as the bringer of joy and words: a captivating storyteller, quick with ideas, someone who brightens a room. Under the carefree surface there is usually a sensitive soul prone to self-doubt.
tong_quan.dong_luc: Expressing themselves and having what they create welcomed by others.
diem_mu: Start many things, finish few once the excitement fades
Use a joke to dodge serious conversations
Scatter your energy across too many things
tong_quan.khi_cang_thang: Talking more, forcing cheerfulness — or the opposite, going completely quiet and criticising themselves.
tong_quan.huong_lon: From 'many ideas' to 'one finished piece of work' — discipline is what turns talent into value.

tinh_cam.cach_yeu: Loves through joy, words and small surprises; wants a relationship with laughter in it.
tinh_cam.can_duoc: To be praised, to be heard, and to be themselves without being called 'childish'.
tinh_cam.diem_mu: Dodges hard conversations by changing the subject; gets bored when the relationship settles into routine.
tinh_cam.hop_kieu_nguoi: Someone who enjoys their humour but is steady enough to bring them back to what matters when needed.
tinh_cam.dau_hieu_lech: When the 3 only jokes and no longer shares anything heartfelt — they are avoiding something.
tinh_cam.hon_nhan: Brings a cheerful atmosphere into the home; needs clearly agreed responsibilities so chores and money do not drift.

cong_viec.the_manh: Communicating, writing, presenting, creating content, working with people.
cong_viec.moi_truong: Lively, with room for new ideas, not too heavy on process.
cong_viec.vai_tro: Communicator, idea person, the face of the team.
cong_viec.cai_bay: Holds too many half-finished projects; gets bored with repetitive work even when it is needed to succeed.
cong_viec.tien_bac: Spends on impulse and is generous with friends; benefits from an automatic system (save first, spend after).

bien_co.kieu_bien_co: Turning points often come when they are forced to choose a single direction, or after a time when their talent was undervalued and they had to prove themselves.
bien_co.bai_hoc: Talent needs one place to pour itself into fully.
bien_co.cach_di_qua: Pick one thing, set a public deadline, and finish it before opening anything new.

tong_quan.chan_dung: Life Path 4 is often described as the foundation builder: disciplined, dependable, moving one solid step at a time. They are not loud, but when they say 'yes' the job gets done.
tong_quan.dong_luc: Stability, order and the feeling of building something that lasts.
diem_mu: Rigid when plans change
Struggle to accept ways of working different from your own
Overwork because rest feels like laziness
tong_quan.khi_cang_thang: Clinging to rules, getting picky and grumbling; taking on more work instead of saying they are tired.
tong_quan.huong_lon: From 'by the book' to 'flexible yet solid' — a good foundation is one that can take change.

tinh_cam.cach_yeu: Loves through steady presence: keeping promises, handling practical matters, building shared plans.
tinh_cam.can_duoc: Loyalty, consistency and a sense of safety — no big surprises.
tinh_cam.diem_mu: Shows affection in a dry way; thinks 'doing for' is enough and forgets 'saying to'.
tinh_cam.hop_kieu_nguoi: Someone who values stability but brings a little extra warmth and lightness.
tinh_cam.dau_hieu_lech: When the relationship is only schedules and duties, with no time left to enjoy together.
tinh_cam.hon_nhan: A solid pillar in finances and household order; needs to deliberately make time for romance as a 'task to do'.

cong_viec.the_manh: Organising, operating, precise work, managing processes and numbers.
cong_viec.moi_truong: Clear structure, measurable goals, being trusted with long-term responsibility.
cong_viec.cai_bay: Does assigned work well but hesitates to take on new work with no clear method; can be left behind when the industry changes.
cong_viec.tien_bac: Saves and builds up steadily; needs to allow themselves to spend on experiences and learning new things.

bien_co.kieu_bien_co: Turning points tend to be moments when the foundation shakes: losing a stable job, a policy change, a long-term plan that has to be rebuilt from scratch.
bien_co.bai_hoc: Real safety comes from the ability to adapt, not from everything standing still.
bien_co.cach_di_qua: When a plan collapses, break the rebuild into the smallest steps you can do this week.

tong_quan.chan_dung: Life Path 5 is often described as a person of freedom and experience: curious, keen to travel, keen to try, drawn to a life with movement in it. They learn by living many lives in one.
tong_quan.dong_luc: Freedom to choose and the feeling that their life is moving.
diem_manh: Willing to try, willing to change
diem_mu: Find long-term commitment hard
Act on impulse when bored
Get drawn into things that give a strong rush
tong_quan.khi_cang_thang: Wanting to leave, change jobs, change places — running from the feeling of being trapped.
tong_quan.huong_lon: From 'freedom from every tie' to 'freedom to choose what is worth committing to' — commitment in the right place is also a kind of freedom.

tinh_cam.cach_yeu: Loves through shared experiences: going places, trying new things, interesting conversations.
tinh_cam.can_duoc: Personal space, trust, and a relationship that is not monotonous.
tinh_cam.diem_mu: Gets bored when things settle; mistakes safety for dullness.
tinh_cam.hop_kieu_nguoi: Someone independent with a rich life of their own who does not hold on too tight.
tinh_cam.dau_hieu_lech: When the 5 starts looking for new thrills outside the relationship — the need for freshness should be voiced before it is too late.
tinh_cam.hon_nhan: Needs a marriage with 'windows': each person has their own space and the two take regular trips together.

cong_viec.the_manh: Sales, communication, negotiation, handling situations, multitasking.
cong_viec.moi_truong: Constant change, lots of travel, meeting new people, control over their own time.
cong_viec.vai_tro: Market opener, crisis handler, cross-industry connector.
cong_viec.cai_bay: Jumps jobs as soon as the novelty wears off, so finds it hard to build depth and position.
cong_viec.tien_bac: Earns fast, spends fast; easily tempted by 'get rich quick' offers — keep an amount you never touch.

bien_co.kieu_bien_co: A 5's life tends to have many turning points: moving home, changing careers, sudden decisions — sometimes chosen, sometimes pushed by circumstances.
bien_co.bai_hoc: Change is only worth something when you learn from it.
bien_co.cach_di_qua: Before each big change, write down: 'am I running towards something, or away from something?'.

tong_quan.chan_dung: Life Path 6 is often described as the person of responsibility and care: family, friends and community turn to them when in need. They have an eye for beauty and a longing to make everything around them harmonious.
tong_quan.dong_luc: Being loved, being needed, and seeing that everyone they look after is all right.
diem_manh: Good taste, able to create a pleasant space
diem_mu: Worry and decide on other people's behalf
Sacrifice, then expect it to be repaid
Perfectionist, struggle to accept imperfection
tong_quan.khi_cang_thang: Anxious, controlling, reminding people constantly; feeling like the only one carrying everything.
tong_quan.huong_lon: From 'caring for everyone' to 'caring for yourself as well' — a burnt-out person cannot care for anyone for long.

tinh_cam.cach_yeu: Loves through looking after: cooking, reminding, running the home, looking towards a shared future.
tinh_cam.can_duoc: Recognition, appreciation for what they do, and a warm home.
tinh_cam.diem_mu: Tends to turn love into duty and management; finds it hard to accept a partner who thinks differently.
tinh_cam.hop_kieu_nguoi: Someone who says thank you, takes responsibility and shares the housework.
tinh_cam.dau_hieu_lech: When the 6 starts keeping score or feels 'treated like the help' — speak up before resentment sets in.
tinh_cam.hon_nhan: Usually makes family the centre of their life; needs to keep a part of life outside the role of spouse or parent.

cong_viec.the_manh: Caring, educating, advising, aesthetics, building community.
cong_viec.moi_truong: Humane values, good relationships, seeing that they are being useful.
cong_viec.vai_tro: Adviser, keeper of the team culture, the one who looks after the team.
cong_viec.cai_bay: Carries other people's work, finds it hard to refuse; does a lot but hesitates to ask for what they are owed.
cong_viec.tien_bac: Spends a lot on family and loved ones; needs a fund of their own for themselves and for later life.

bien_co.kieu_bien_co: Turning points are often tied to family: getting married, having children, caring for parents, or a moment of choosing between responsibility and a personal dream.
bien_co.bai_hoc: Loving does not mean carrying everything.
bien_co.cach_di_qua: When the family load piles up, split the tasks by name — and put your own name on the list of people to be cared for.

tong_quan.chan_dung: Life Path 7 is often described as the truth-seeker: likes to dig deep, asks 'why', needs time alone to think. They may seem distant, but inside is a rich world.
tong_quan.dong_luc: Understanding things at the root and finding the real meaning behind the surface.
diem_manh: Good intuition, notice what others miss
diem_mu: Closed off, find it hard to share feelings
Sceptical, slow to trust people
Think too much and do too little
tong_quan.khi_cang_thang: Pulling inward, long silences, turning sarcastic or cold.
tong_quan.huong_lon: From 'understanding alone' to 'sharing what you understand' — wisdom has value when someone receives it.

tinh_cam.cach_yeu: Loves slowly and deeply; shows it through honest conversation rather than sweet words.
tinh_cam.can_duoc: Respect for their quiet, and a person who understands without needing much explanation.
tinh_cam.diem_mu: Finds it hard to open up and leaves the partner guessing; tends to retreat when asked for a lot of emotion.
tinh_cam.hop_kieu_nguoi: Someone deep who respects privacy and is patient enough to wait for them to open up.
tinh_cam.dau_hieu_lech: When the 7 increasingly lives in parallel — present but not sharing.
tinh_cam.hon_nhan: Needs a marriage with personal space; should schedule regular talks so the two do not become strangers.

cong_viec.the_manh: Research, analysis, deep expertise, solving complex problems.
cong_viec.moi_truong: Quiet, quality-focused, with time to think and few pointless meetings.
cong_viec.cai_bay: Good but unknown because they hesitate to put themselves forward; perfectionism can slow progress.
cong_viec.tien_bac: Careful, commits money only after understanding it well; sometimes downplays money because it seems less important than knowledge.

bien_co.kieu_bien_co: Turning points usually come from within: a crisis of belief, losing something that seemed certain, forcing them to find meaning again.
bien_co.bai_hoc: Some questions have no answer, only a way of living with them.
bien_co.cach_di_qua: When things fall apart, give yourself quiet time — but set a date to come back and reconnect with people.

tong_quan.chan_dung: Life Path 8 is often described as the person of achievement and practical power: spotting opportunities, organising resources, wanting measurable results. They carry authority, and life tends to test them through money and power themselves.
tong_quan.dong_luc: Concrete success, recognition and financial independence.
diem_mu: Measure worth by achievement, including your own
Too hard-edged, rarely show vulnerability
Get swallowed by work and neglect relationships
tong_quan.khi_cang_thang: Tight control, short temper, working even harder to regain the feeling of being in charge.
tong_quan.huong_lon: From 'power to have' to 'power to give' — success lasts when it lifts other people.

tinh_cam.cach_yeu: Loves through protecting and providing: securing material life, building a solid future.
tinh_cam.can_duoc: Respect, trust in their ability, and a partner who shares that ambition.
tinh_cam.diem_mu: Tends to treat money and gifts as a substitute for words of love; finds it hard to say 'I need you'.
tinh_cam.hop_kieu_nguoi: Someone confident with a career of their own who is not overshadowed by a strong personality.
tinh_cam.dau_hieu_lech: When every conversation is only about work and money — or when there is a fight over who decides.
tinh_cam.hon_nhan: Usually builds a solid material base; needs a clear agreement on shared and separate finances from the start.

cong_viec.the_manh: Business, management, finance, major negotiations, building organisations.
cong_viec.moi_truong: Room to advance, rewards tied to results, a scale big enough to make full use of them.
cong_viec.cai_bay: Overreaches when confident; putting results above people wears the team out.
cong_viec.tien_bac: Able to earn and manage large sums; an 8's life often has financial ups and downs — keep a reserve fund and someone who pushes back.

bien_co.kieu_bien_co: Turning points tend to revolve around money, status and authority: a major promotion, a business failure, a dispute, or a time of starting again from zero.
bien_co.bai_hoc: A person's worth is not on the balance sheet.
bien_co.cach_di_qua: When you fail, separate 'the thing failed' from 'I failed' — then count what is still there: skills, relationships, health.

tong_quan.chan_dung: Life Path 9 is often described as a person of broad vision and generosity: caring about things bigger than themselves, quick to empathise, full of ideals. Their life tends to include moments of letting go to turn a new page.
tong_quan.dong_luc: Doing something meaningful for other people and for the world.
diem_manh: Broad vision, think of the many
Artistic flair and the ability to inspire
diem_mu: Idealise people, then feel let down
Give until you forget yourself
Struggle to let go of the past even while saying you have
tong_quan.khi_cang_thang: Distant, sad, feeling misunderstood; sometimes withdrawing from everything.
tong_quan.huong_lon: From 'saving the world' to 'serving within your limits' — kindness also needs to know when enough is enough.

tinh_cam.cach_yeu: Loves generously and romantically, ready to forgive and to sacrifice.
tinh_cam.can_duoc: To have their ideals understood and to be loved in their fragile parts too.
tinh_cam.diem_mu: Tends to love the image they imagine more than the real person; carries sadness without saying it.
tinh_cam.hop_kieu_nguoi: Someone with depth and clear values who can gently bring them back to everyday life.
tinh_cam.dau_hieu_lech: When the 9 starts 'giving' to the whole world and forgets the person beside them, or quietly prepares to leave.
tinh_cam.hon_nhan: A generous partner; needs to pay attention to everyday matters (money, the home) that they tend to treat as small.

cong_viec.the_manh: Inspiring, teaching, the arts, social work, seeing the big picture.
cong_viec.moi_truong: A clear mission, impact on many people, doing what they believe in.
cong_viec.vai_tro: The one who lights the fire, adviser, representative of shared values.
cong_viec.cai_bay: Works for the ideal and forgets living conditions; prone to burnout or disillusionment.
cong_viec.tien_bac: Does not put much weight on money and gives easily; needs to learn that having money means more ability to help.

bien_co.kieu_bien_co: A 9's life has many closings: ending a relationship, leaving a place, closing a chapter — each one a lesson in letting go.
bien_co.bai_hoc: An ending is part of the cycle, not a failure.
bien_co.cach_di_qua: When a chapter closes, do a small ritual to say goodbye — then look towards the new one.

tong_quan.chan_dung: 11 is a master number, often described as an intensified 2: very sharp intuition, the ability to inspire, but also a high level of nervous tension. They see things others have not yet seen, and life asks them to learn to live with that sensitivity.
tong_quan.dong_luc: Bringing light, meaning or faith to other people.
diem_mu: Anxious, tense, easily overwhelmed by emotion
Expect very much of yourself, then torment yourself
Find it hard to bring ideas down to earth
tong_quan.khi_cang_thang: Restless, sleepless, strong emotional swings; at times doubting themselves completely.
tong_quan.huong_lon: From 'feeling everything' to 'choosing what to feel' — sensitivity needs tending like a fine instrument.

tinh_cam.cach_yeu: Loves deeply, bonding soul to soul; hopes for a relationship with meaning beyond the everyday.
tinh_cam.can_duoc: To be understood without being called 'too sensitive', and to feel emotionally safe.
tinh_cam.diem_mu: Idealises the partner; easily hurt by small details and reads too much into things.
tinh_cam.hop_kieu_nguoi: Someone calm and steady who helps them 'touch the ground' without putting out their ideals.
tinh_cam.dau_hieu_lech: When the 11 goes silent for long stretches or their feelings swing unpredictably — they are overloaded.
tinh_cam.hon_nhan: Needs a regular family rhythm to keep their nerves balanced; shared routines that help them relax are a good idea.

cong_viec.the_manh: Inspiring, advising, creating, work that calls for intuition and vision.
cong_viec.moi_truong: Rich in meaning, free of harsh conflict, respectful of creativity.
cong_viec.cai_bay: Plenty of vision but hard to execute; burns out quickly in a fiercely competitive setting.
cong_viec.tien_bac: Not good with the details of money; needs a person or a tool to manage it regularly.

bien_co.kieu_bien_co: Turning points are often 'awakenings': an experience that completely changes how they see life, usually following a period of great strain.
bien_co.bai_hoc: Sensitivity is a gift when there is solid ground to stand on.
bien_co.cach_di_qua: In shaky times, keep simple bodily routines (sleep, walking, regular meals) as an anchor.

tong_quan.chan_dung: 22 is a master number, often called 'the master builder' — like a 4 carrying the vision of an 11: wanting to turn big ideas into real structures. The pressure they put on themselves is usually very high.
tong_quan.dong_luc: Building something of lasting value for many people.
diem_manh: Big vision paired with a practical mind
Steadfast, able to bear long-term pressure
diem_mu: The pressure to do 'something big' makes it hard to start
Controlling, taking on too much
Sacrifice personal life for work
tong_quan.khi_cang_thang: Frozen by expectations that are too high, or working like a machine and growing distant from everyone.
tong_quan.huong_lon: From 'I must build something great' to 'lay one good brick at a time' — a great structure is the sum of ordinary days.

tinh_cam.cach_yeu: Loves through building: securing the foundation, long-term plans, steady protection.
tinh_cam.can_duoc: A partner who understands the size of their goals and shares the load.
tinh_cam.diem_mu: Puts work first; shows little affection and assumes the partner 'just knows'.
tinh_cam.hop_kieu_nguoi: Someone patient with a life of their own who can pull them back to the small moments.
tinh_cam.dau_hieu_lech: When important family occasions keep being 'put off' because of work.
tinh_cam.hon_nhan: A major pillar; needs to learn to rest and be fully present in family moments.

cong_viec.the_manh: Managing large projects, designing systems, building organisations, strategic planning.
cong_viec.moi_truong: Wide influence, long-running projects, being given resources.
cong_viec.cai_bay: Plans that are too big for the resources at hand; finds it hard to trust and delegate.
cong_viec.tien_bac: Able to create great value; should go slow and steady and avoid putting all the capital into one project.

bien_co.kieu_bien_co: Turning points tend to be moments of being given (or taking on) a big responsibility beyond their years, or an unfinished project that has to be rebuilt.
bien_co.bai_hoc: A big vision needs big patience.
bien_co.cach_di_qua: Break the big goal into 90-day milestones; celebrate each small one so you do not burn out.

tong_quan.chan_dung: 33 is a rare master number, often described as an intensified 6: great compassion, a wish to lift up and heal others. They lead by serving — people follow because they feel genuinely cared for.
tong_quan.dong_luc: Seeing other people grow and heal thanks to their support.
diem_manh: A strong sense of responsibility to the community
diem_mu: Carry other people's pain as if it were your own
Sacrifice to the point of forgetting to care for yourself
Set moral expectations too high for yourself and others
tong_quan.khi_cang_thang: Quiet exhaustion, feeling responsible for everyone's happiness.
tong_quan.huong_lon: From 'saving everyone' to 'helping people stand on their own' — wise service is service with limits.

tinh_cam.cach_yeu: Loves wholeheartedly and forgivingly, wanting to lift up the person they love.
tinh_cam.can_duoc: To be cared for in return, and to feel they do not always have to be the strong one.
tinh_cam.diem_mu: Tends to love in order to 'rescue' someone; endures too much instead of setting limits.
tinh_cam.hop_kieu_nguoi: Someone mature who can look after themselves and knows how to care for them back.
tinh_cam.dau_hieu_lech: When the 33 only gives and no longer receives, and starts to feel tired of their own compassion.
tinh_cam.hon_nhan: The emotional anchor of the whole family; needs responsibilities shared evenly and to accept help.

cong_viec.the_manh: Education, care, counselling, community leadership, healing arts.
cong_viec.moi_truong: Humane values, where devotion is valued and fairly paid.
cong_viec.cai_bay: Works for free, burns out from kindness; hesitates to talk about money.
cong_viec.tien_bac: Often uses money to help others; needs a safety fund of their own before helping.

bien_co.kieu_bien_co: Turning points are usually times of carrying others: a loved one unwell, family hardship, or a burnout that forces them to learn to accept help.
bien_co.bai_hoc: To care for others in the long run, care for yourself first.
bien_co.cach_di_qua: When the load piles up, write down which tasks are truly yours — and hand back the ones that are not.

source.ten: Reference compilation (editorial draft, 2026) following the Balliett–Jordan tradition and common numerology books
source.luu_y: Draft shown by decision of the project owner (2026-09-30); a status column allows gradual review. A cultural reference, not a forecast.
